"use client";
import { useAuiState } from "@assistant-ui/store";
//#region src/primitives/messagePart/useMessagePartFile.ts
/**
* @deprecated Use {@link useAuiState} to select and narrow `s.part`.
* Return `null` for optional rendering, or throw inside the selector to
* preserve the old hook's strict behavior.
*
* @example
* ```tsx
* const file = useAuiState((s) => {
*   if (s.part.type !== "file") return null;
*   return s.part;
* });
* ```
*
* See the {@link https://assistant-ui.com/docs/migrations/v0-12 migration guide}.
*/
const useMessagePartFile = () => {
	return useAuiState(_temp);
};
function _temp(s) {
	if (s.part.type !== "file") throw new Error("MessagePartFile can only be used inside file message parts.");
	return s.part;
}
//#endregion
export { useMessagePartFile };
